description: Send a request for a service in Japan. Fixed-price services (phone_call JPY 1,500, restaurant_booking JPY 3,000, interpreting JPY 5,000 per 30 min) return the quote and payment details immediately. Other services get a fixed quote from a person within 2 hours (JST 09:00-21:00); requests sent outside hours are handled from 09:00. No email is needed: follow up with get_request_status. Creating a request is free and does not move any money. Full refund if we cannot do the task or you cancel before work starts.

callback_url.description: Optional public https URL that receives status updates as JSON

contact_email.description: Optional email for the quote and result

details.description: What, where, when, how many people, names, constraints

language.description: Preferred language for replies, e.g. en, ja, zh

name: request_service
title: Request a service in Japan
